analogy.rationale: RPS6KA1/2/3 (p90 ribosomal S6 kinases) are downstream effectors of ERK/MAPK signaling and also regulate translation; inhibitors of translation (protein synthesis inhibitors) and of upstream MAPK/mTOR pathways should yield the most similar transcriptional responses, while direct kinase inhibitors of the same family are not represented in the list.
